title: Order to Establish the Dome and Slim Landscape Units and Objectives, 31 October 2002
madeUnder: Forest Practices Code Act s. 4(1) and (2); continued as a Land Act s. 93.4 objective by Land Act s. 93.8
transcribedFrom: signed PDF, text layer checked against the pages

provisions.heading: Dome and Slim landscape units established
quotes: Pursuant to section 4 (1) of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act (the Act)

provisions.heading: Dome: old growth distribution through OGMAs
quotes: by maintaining the old growth management areas (OGMAs) as shown on Map 1
Meet the distribution of old growth for each Landscape Unit / Biogeoclimatic Unit

provisions.heading: Dome: maintain the mapped OGMAs
quotes: Maintain old growth management areas, which are established as shown on the attached Map 1.

provisions.heading: Dome: cutting in OGMAs only for insect or disease control
quotes: Cutting trees within OGMAs, is limited to circumstances where it is absolutely necessary for insect or disease infestation
When intervention in OGMAs is required because of a forest health threat to adjacent areas

provisions.heading: Dome: no roads in OGMAs without no practicable option
quotes: Do not construct roads in OGMAs unless there is no other practicable option.
Any temporary roads that are built in OGMAs must be deactivated, rehabilitated and planted as soon as possible.

provisions.heading: Dome: fire suppression in OGMAs
quotes: Fire suppression is permitted within OGMAs for the purposes of maintaining the integrity of the OGMAs.

provisions.heading: Slim: old growth distribution through OGMAs
quotes: by maintaining the old growth management areas (OGMAs) as shown on Map 2
Meet the distribution of old growth for each Landscape Unit / Biogeoclimatic Unit

provisions.heading: Slim: maintain the mapped OGMAs
quotes: Maintain old growth management areas, which are established as shown on the attached Map 2.

provisions.heading: Slim: cutting in OGMAs only for insect or disease control
quotes: Cutting trees within OGMAs, is limited to circumstances where it is absolutely necessary for insect or disease infestation
When intervention in OGMAs is required because of a forest health threat to adjacent areas

provisions.heading: Slim: no roads in OGMAs without no practicable option
quotes: Do not construct roads in OGMAs unless there is no other practicable option.
Any temporary roads that are built in OGMAs must be deactivated, rehabilitated and planted as soon as possible.

provisions.heading: Slim: fire suppression in OGMAs
quotes: Fire suppression is permitted within OGMAs for the purposes of maintaining the integrity of the OGMAs.

provisions.heading: Slim: range use continues in OGMAs
quotes: Range use is permitted to continue, where it currently exists, through authorized tenures.
Range use must proceed in a way that is sensitive to the old growth values of the OGMA.

provisions.heading: Forest development plans consistent with the order
quotes: Pursuant to Section 10 (1) (d) (ii) of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act

provisions.heading: Effective date
quotes: Effective Date of Order This Order takes effect on October 31, 2002.
